summary: Albay 3rd District representative with 365 principal-authored bills. Authored a universal basic income for all Filipinos, a facility for LGUs to retake privatized utilities, a national basic wage system abolishing wage boards, NFA palay procurement from excess rice tariffs, estate tax abolition with a deferred succession tax, right to information, an anti-dynasty ban and party and proportional representation strengthening.
caveat: Universal basic income alone would support a stronger left score; capped at -2 because estate tax abolition and fuel-tax cuts pull right and conduct beyond bills was not reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored universal basic income (-4), LGU retaking of privatized utilities (-3), a national basic wage system (-2) and NFA palay procurement (-2), against estate tax abolition and petroleum excise suspension (+1 to +3).
